audits.note: a found break stays visible; internal test runs are not audits

packet_uses.note: a document-use receipt records that a research decision was taken on an exact packet; it is not evidence of investment benefit, performance or endorsement

refusals.note: receipted refusals of unsupported conclusions only; automated check-claim telemetry and receipt qualification failures are not refusal receipts

artifacts.note: successful_cohort_artifacts are the artifacts of successful qualified attempts — not all tested artifacts; site/endpoint/chain checks are not package reproductions

exact_target_evidence.note: no target manifest supplied; exact-target coverage is not measured (not zero)

program_exact_artifact_evidence.note: qualified successful attempts whose exact wheel/sdist bytes were verified — any release (program-wide)

registration.note: no registration record adopted; counts are unwindowed

definitions.audits: AUDIT_BREAK_ATTEMPT receipts: outsider attempts to break a published check (a found break stays visible); internal test runs are not audits
definitions.challenges: structured challenges by disposition; adverse = OPEN or CONFIRMED; RESOLVED keeps the original finding
definitions.packet_uses: document-use receipts bound to an exact packet digest and exported with permission
definitions.pilots: BYOS pilot engagements with a signed scope (none: counsel review is the blocker)
definitions.refusals: REFUSAL receipts: a real user asked for an unsupported conclusion and the product refused, reviewed separately; automated check-claim telemetry and receipt qualification failures are not counted here
definitions.replications: REPLICATION receipts: attempts to reproduce published artifacts; primary population = qualified attempts (failed/inconclusive retained); successful reported separately
definitions.witnesses: WITNESS_REVIEW receipts: people who examined the methodology and left a reviewable, reviewed receipt; unreceipted relationships are never counted

not_advice: Research and education only. Not investment advice. No composite trust score is computed.

target.note: no release target manifest supplied; exact-target coverage is UNBOUND (not zero)
